source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
If there are no building records try to find in the code reports
3. If there is no documentation, run a building search to identify relevant buildings using the address and/or location
4. Identify the lot number from the address - this is the best identification
5. Create a building record (and lot record if not already created)
6. Ensure that the building record is the parent object on the inspection record - this is the building record identification
7. Enter a description of the building inconsistencies in the inspection record
8. If the inspection record identified a barrier, a non-compliant space or a placard without a sidewalk, ensure that the inspection record is linked to the inspection or placard record in this project
9. Once all the inconsistencies are entered, update the inspection record to reflect the complete status

The following instructions for creating a new building as the parent record of an inspection record use the new data import wizard to connect the inspection record
